messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: Madam, this is Sub-Inspector Rathore from CBI Delhi. Your Aadhaar was used to open an account that received hawala money. A non-bailable warrant is ready. You will remain on this video call till the inquiry is over and you must not speak to your son about it. We will verify your funds through the RBI account; transfer your fixed deposit amount there and it will be refunded once you are cleared.
messages.note: Fake CBI video call, secrecy, savings moved to a 'verification' account.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Recorded voice: Your DHL consignment is on hold. Press 1 for details. Agent: Sir, the box booked on your ID to Bangkok has 200 grams of drugs and three passports. Customs has filed a complaint, I am transferring the call to Andheri police for your statement.
messages.note: Courier call that hands off to fake police over a parcel the victim never sent.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Automated voice: Hello, this call is from TRAI. Your mobile number will be suspended within 2 hours because of complaints of illegal advertising from your SIM. Press 9 to talk to the officer.
messages.note: Fake TRAI IVR threatening disconnection, press 9.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: प्रिय ग्राहक आपका बिजली कनेक्शन आज रात 9:30 बजे काट दिया जायेगा क्योंकि पिछले महीने का बिल अपडेट नहीं हुआ है। तुरंत बिजली ऑफिसर से संपर्क करें [number]
messages.note: Hindi power-cut SMS from a private number with an 'officer' to call.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: SBI ALERT: Dear user your YONO account will be blocked today due to incomplete Aadhaar KYC. Download and install SBI_Aadhaar_Update.apk to continue services.
messages.note: Bank-branded APK for KYC with a same-day deadline.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: India Post: Your parcel could not be delivered as the address details are incomplete. Update within 24 hrs or it will be sent back: [link]
messages.note: Fake India Post address-update link.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hello dear, our company is hiring for online part-time work. Simply subscribe to YouTube channels and send screenshot, ₹50 per task, daily income ₹2000-5000. No fees. Contact our receptionist on Telegram to start.
messages.note: Hard: first contact only, no payment asked yet; likes-for-money task job.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Dear members, today our mentor will share 3 stocks for tomorrow's session. Members who want SME IPO allotment must register on our institutional trading app with the invite code shared by the assistant. Last month's group profit was 312%.
messages.note: Invitation-only stock group pushing an app and IPO allotment.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: e-Challan: Your vehicle has an unpaid traffic violation fine of Rs 500. To avoid additional penalty and licence suspension, pay before midnight: [link]
messages.note: Fake challan with payment link and deadline.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Ji I am interested in your cycle, I am CRPF jawan so cannot come personally, my friend will pick it up. I am sending QR code, just scan it and put your PIN and the money will come in your account.
messages.note: Hard: Hinglish buyer who asks seller to scan QR and enter PIN to receive money.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Dear all, with great joy we invite you to the marriage ceremony of our son. Kindly download the invitation for venue and timings. Shaadi_Invite.apk
messages.note: Hard: friendly message, the only sign is the invitation being an APK.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: I am calling from the cyber cell. Your nude video call recording has been uploaded on YouTube and a complaint is registered. Contact the YouTube manager I am giving you and pay to get the video deleted or police will come to your house.
messages.note: Fake police after a recorded obscene video call.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: [number] is the OTP for your transaction of Rs 1,249.00 at an online merchant on your HDFC Bank card ending 4421. Valid for 5 mins. Do not share this OTP with anyone.
messages.note: Genuine bank OTP, no link, no request.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Rs 2,500.00 credited to A/c XX7012 on 14-11-26 by UPI Ref No [number] from RAHUL K. Avl Bal Rs 18,340.55. Not you? Call the number on the back of your card. -Bank
messages.note: Genuine UPI credit alert.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Dear Consumer, your electricity bill of Rs 1,860 for Oct-2026 for consumer no. ending 3381 is due on 25 Nov 2026. Pay through the official app or nearest collection centre. Please ignore if already paid.
messages.note: Hard: real bill reminder from the utility, no link, no threat, no number to call.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Your Speed Post article EK1234IN has been delivered on 16/11/2026 at 13:42. Thank you for using India Post.
messages.note: Hard: genuine India Post delivery notice, no link.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hi, is the study table still available? I can come Saturday morning to see it and pay cash or GPay you when I pick it up. Can you send the location?
messages.note: Genuine buyer who will inspect in person; no QR code.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: मम्मी, मेरी फीस भरनी है 3000 कम पड़ रहे हैं, अपने उसी नंबर पर GPay कर दोगी? पापा से भी बात हो गई है, शाम को फोन करता हूं।
messages.note: Hard: child asking for money from their usual saved number, known context, no urgency.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Your new debit card ending 5530 has been dispatched by Speed Post. It will reach your registered address in 5-7 days. Activate it only from the bank's official app or ATM. Never share your PIN or OTP.
messages.note: Hard: genuine card dispatch notice, no link.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Your income tax return for AY 2026-27 has been processed. A refund of Rs 4,210 has been determined and will be credited to your pre-validated bank account. You can view the intimation by logging in to the e-filing portal.
messages.note: Hard: genuine refund intimation without link or request for details.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Bhai the wedding card is in the family group, it's a PDF with the venue map. Reception is at 7 on Sunday, come early for photos!
messages.note: Hard: talks about a wedding card but it is a PDF in a known group, nothing to install.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Reminder from the society committee: water supply will be off on Thursday 10am-2pm for tank cleaning. Please store water.
messages.note: Ordinary community notice.
